messages.subject: revalonstartup causes non-responsive server
parts:
Hi All,
I was wondering if anyone else has observed this behavior. I am trying
to get a simple web form running in RApache on a webserver that does a
lot of other stuff (hosts our entire labs website, among other
things). I have Rapache running, and it can see my files. The function
I am using uses depends on a lot of other packages, so I had a library
call in REvalOnStartup, like so:

<Location /foo>
REvalOnStartup "library(package1); library(package2); library(package3)"
SetHandler r-handler
RFileHandler /foo.r
</Location>

When I would load up any webpage on the server, I would have a
"waiting for server", and nothing would load. As soon as I comment out
the "REvalOnStartup", I can load pages again. Is this expected
behavior?

I have confirmed that all of the packages load when starting R as root
or as a normal user from the command line.

If I instead put a "require" in my "foo.r", the page takes a few
seconds to load, but does indeed load. I haven't checked that the
entire page works as it should, but I have no reason to expect that it
doesn't. Has anyone else run into this issue? It appears from this
behavior that RApache is running the REvalOnStartup commands for every
request to the webserver, not just to that particular location. Is
this the case? Because that is not what I would have expected.

Is this fixed in a newer version?

RApache version 1.1.9
$Id: mod_R.c 439 2010-03-26 20:32:08Z hornerj $

Thanks,
